capabilities: Shows notes, tasks, calendar and media as cards
Arranges and resizes cards into workspaces
Runs terminal, web, music and recording cards
Reads and writes data in existing notes
Provides keyboard shortcuts and command palette actions
extras: Atrium Complete modules require a paid license with a 30-day trial; some cards depend on macOS helpers or external programs such as Python 3, expect, icalBuddy and Claude Code.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in customizable dashboard for seeing notes, tasks, calendar and media together.

relations.evidence: A spoken command can ask Claude Code, in a terminal card, if you turn that on.
Calendar events (macOS) read and edit the Calendar app's events through atrium-calendar
Without it, Atrium reads events from icalBuddy if you have it installed.
Your own music files and YouTube links, with lyrics and playlists.

summary: Modular homepage and workspace that shows notes, tasks, calendar, media and utilities as cards.
